description: The company's active discounts: codes guests type at checkout, automatic ones, and the pay-in-full discount, each with its value, booking window (`start_date`..`end_date`), stay window (`stay_from`..`stay_to`) and the boats it covers (`all_boats`, else `boat_ids`). An empty list means the company runs no discount.

company_id.description: Company id, from list_boats (`company_id`) or get_company.
